lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好了！给侦探的八百，凑齐了。数了三遍，一个不少。
lines.en: Done! I've saved up the eight hundred for the detective. Counted three times. Not a credit short.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 包括那块我死活不肯承认是废料的东西。它拆出来的材料卖了钱，你不许看不起它。
lines.en: Including that thing I refused to admit was scrap. The parts from it sold for money, so don't look down on it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探的钱凑齐了。剩下的货卖给另一家，短工那边也肯预支。
lines.en: I've got the detective's money. I sold the rest to another buyer, and the short-work people agreed to an advance.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 照样干活。工钱预支了，活不会自己干完。
lines.en: I'll still work. The advance is paid, but the work won't finish itself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 吊坠也卖了。别盯着我的领口看，我自己都还没习惯。
lines.en: I sold the locket too. Stop staring at my neckline. I'm still getting used to it myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 卖给谁我知道。先办母亲的事。总不能因为我舍不得，把别的都耽误了。
lines.en: I know who I sold it to. Mother comes first. I can't hold everything else back just because I'm reluctant.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探明天开始查。他答应先找母亲的工作记录，不直接去公司问人。
lines.en: The investigator starts tomorrow. He agreed to check the work records first, rather than question people at the company.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 查清楚，就拿给法院看。可法院会不会看，我不知道。
lines.en: Once it's clear, I'll take it to court. Whether the court will look at it, I don't know.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我连上层区的门都进不去，请不起律师。以前那些朋友，没一个肯接我的通讯。
lines.en: I can't even get through the upper district gate, let alone hire a lawyer. None of my old friends will take my calls.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我只知道先查。查清楚了，总会有下一步。
lines.en: All I know is to keep investigating. Once it's clear, there will be a next step.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 差点忘了。母亲的复核材料，正式递进去了。
lines.en: Almost forgot. Mother's review materials were formally submitted.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这次给回执了。调查报告、转移记录、研究签收单，一样没少。
lines.en: This time they gave a receipt. Investigation report, transfer record, research receipt. Nothing missing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 日期我让他们当面写清楚，省得下回又说找不到。
lines.en: I made them write the dates clearly in front of me, so next time they can't say they can't find them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲的清白，可不能只靠谁嘴上答应过的一句话。
lines.en: Mother's name can't rest on someone's verbal promise.

lines.speaker: News
lines.text: 空间站最大水培农场前负责人挪用公款案经复核，原判决正式撤销。相关指控与程序问题将另行调查。
lines.en: The embezzlement conviction of the former head of the station's largest hydroponics farm has been formally overturned on review. Related charges and procedural issues will be investigated separately.

lines.speaker: News
lines.text: 营养果自主结籽试种继续推进，研究人员表示会继续公开核验试种记录。
lines.en: Trial planting of self-seeding Nutrifruit continues. The researchers say trial records will remain open for verification.
